courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: To toggle between logging in and sign-up,
we have to bind this button and also manage the state in which we are inside of our component.
So are we in login or are we in sign-up mode?
That is something we'll have to manage.
Now first of all on that button here, I will add a new click listener which we'll call or which we'll execute,
onSwitchAuthMode or whatever you want to name this,
so it'll basically execute a method which we of course now have to add to the auth.page.ts file.
Now onSwitchAuthMode should do just that, it should switch our authentication mode and therefore I
will add a new property here at the top which I will name isLogin and you can name this whatever you want.
The default let's say is true
so that we start in login mode
and the idea then is that in the onSwitchAuthMode method here, we set this isLogin equal to what
it's currently not,
so we invert its value, so it's not this login and this will simply make sure that if it currently
is true, we set this to false, if it currently is false we set it to true,
that is all I'm doing here.
Now back in the auth page, this is now able to execute onSwitchAuthMode
but of course I now want to reflect the current state and also use it when we submit the form.
So first of all, let's reflect it here.
Instead of saying switch to login, we want to output a dynamic value here and I will check the value
of isLogin and if that is truem then we are in login mode, so we can switch to sign-up mode,
so I'll say switch to sign-up then.
Otherwise isLogin is false, then we are in sign-up mode,
we can switch to login mode,
so here I'll say login. I also want to output this in the ion-title up there,
so instead of saying just authenticate, I'll check if isLogin is true and if it is, I'll say login
here, otherwise sign-up to show in which mode we currently are.
Now let's save that and let's see if it works. As this application reloads,
here we see login and we see switch to sign-up and if I press the button, we see switch to login
and
up there, we see sign-up.
So that's the authentication for now,
let's now proceed to the new offer page here
and let's make sure that we can add a new offer.
